name: ICE BofA US High Yield Index Option-Adjusted Spread
description: Daily Option-Adjusted Spread (OAS) of the ICE BofA US High Yield Index (Series BAMLH0A0HYM2) measuring corporate credit risk premia over spot Treasury curves.

etl.script: WITH raw_data AS (SELECT UNNEST(observations) AS obs FROM read_json_auto('{{CORS_PROXY}}https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations?series_id=BAMLH0A0HYM2&file_type=json&api_key={{FRED_API_KEY}}')) SELECT CAST(obs.date AS TIMESTAMP) AS date, CAST(NULLIF(obs.value, '.') AS FLOAT32) AS spread FROM raw_data WHERE obs.value != '.';
